nom: florence by mills Clear Canvas Milky Oil Cleansing Balm

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin describe the balm as effective at cutting oil and makeup without leaving skin greasy afterward, though a couple say the product itself feels oily going on and warn it must be rinsed thoroughly to avoid clogging.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or drier skin report it cleanses without stripping or leaving a dry after-feel, calling the wash-off smooth and non-drying.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report balanced results, with less oily T-zone the next day and skin that stays soft without feeling either dry or oily, though one combination-sensitive reviewer broke out after a few days of use.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers say the balm is gentle with no irritation, redness, or eczema flare-ups even removing eye makeup, but a couple with sensitive or sensitive-combination skin report breakouts or a slightly greasy after-feel.
segments.mature: No reviews specifically identify mature or aging skin.

concerns.aging: No reviewer discusses anti-aging effects specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers say the balm leaves skin hydrated, soft, and not dry, including one who says it did not leave a dry feeling upon waking; one reviewer with acne-prone skin notes it left her skin very slightly dry afterward, fixed with moisturizer.
concerns.redness: Two reviewers note reduced redness or irritation over time, and one sensitive-skin reviewer specifically reports no redness after use.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers mention the formula replenishing skin with ceramides and vitamin E and not stripping natural oils, describing skin as refreshed and reinforced rather than compromised.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports one side of her face, which had been struggling to clear, cleared up within three days of use; another reports the balm helped clear her complexion.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin report no new breakouts and one used it during an active breakout with good results, but two other reviewers explicitly report new breakouts appearing after a few days of use.
concerns.oiliness: Many reviewers say it removes excess oil and leaves skin oil-free through the day or after emulsifying to a milk/foam, but a few say the balm itself feels greasy or vaseline-like on application and one calls it too greasy to be worth the extra step.

extraits.texte: I was provided a free sample as part of the #florencepanel by florence by mills to try the product and write an honest review. I have very sensitive combination skin. I liked the texture and how easily this product took off my makeup, however, after a few days of using it, my face began to breakout. Overall, I think it's probably a great product just unfortunately not the best for my skin.

First and foremost to disclose I was given this product to be part of the Fall #FlorencePanel. That being said this is my first time being sent a free product to try and based off of what I have seen I was really anxious. My skin is very temperamental combination skin. I previously have used CeraVe after about a decade of not having anything work. It worked but in the last year I wanted to try something else. I currently use the rose water spray and the clear the way products by Florence By Mills. That being said this is all new for me but I adore it. More importantly the Clear Canvas Milky Oil Cleansing Balm. It not only leaves my skin feeling hydrated and refreshed but does not leave me with a dry feeling after or an oily one which I often have no matter what product I use. The only downside is I am not the biggest fan of not having caps since I share a bathroom with my husband and he has his own skin care and we are avid tattoo getters so we sometimes have peelies on our counter from healing tattoos. But the product itself was fantastic, it also resulted in my skin feeling softer and generally less irritated. I have also been struggling with clearing one side of my face and within three days my skin had cleared up with this product. ON TOP OF ALL OF THIS. It removed my work makeup and costuming makeup incredibly well. I would say absolutely try it if you struggle with skin care like I do. Also, it smells absolutely INCREDIBLE.

I was provided a #FLORENCEPANEL free sample by Florence by mills to try and write an honest review. I love this oil cleansing balm!! I have been using it for a couple days and it has left my skin so soft and hasn't caused any new breakouts. I have sensitive acne prone skin and it doesn't bother me. In the before pic, I caked on foundation and waterproof mascara. after using about a dime sized amount and emulsifying it with water, my skin in the second photo is the after result. My skin is so soft but it very slightly left my skin dry. Putting on a moisturizer after will fix it no problem. Overall this is a great product.

I was provided a #FLORENCEPANEL free sample by Florence by Mills and was so surprised ar how good this product is. I have very sensitive skin and most makeup removers and cleansing balms iritate my skin and cause an excema flare up, but this product was so gentle and smooth. I am also outside everyday and felt as though the cleansing balm truly removed all the sunscreen and makeup from my face! Truly an amazing product and I highly recommend.

I love a lot of Florence products and bought this hoping to be able to skip a step in my routine. I don't have a problem with the packaging, I think being able to squeeze it on your hands or cotton pad is convenient and had no issues. My main issue is that the product is SO greasy! It makes my face feel oily instantly and it does not wash off easily. You are left with a thick, oily residue on your face and you are just wiping around your makeup or sunscreen making it worse and harder to remove from the eyes and other areas. I have to use several cotton pads/squares and then add in some micellar water and it takes way too long to remove. So definitely did not save on time and actually added a step. If using in the shower maybe it would be easier, but that's not what I was looking for. Clean-it and other products offer the same results without that heavy greasy feeling like vasoline on your face. I would not recommend.

extraits.titre: If you have not bought this product. Do it today!
extraits.texte: I received a free sample of this product as part of the #florencepanel, and I've been using it for the past few days. Let me tell you—I love it! It leaves my skin feeling soft, and I've noticed that it's not dry when I wake up. Since I have a combination of dry and oily skin, my face also stays oil-free throughout the day. As a bonus, my skin is glowing!

I have always been in the hunt for an oil cleansing balm that won't clog my pores. Florence kindly gifted me this cleansing balm and has truly been so amazing on my skin. Not only does it take all of my makeup, it also does not strip my skin of moisture #florencepanel
